foreignQualification.feeBasis: Flat filing fee of $115.00 for the Foreign Application (Form FA); foreign applications are filed by paper and information reports filed with them carry their own fees.
foreignQualification.formName: FA - Foreign Application - LLC, LLP, LP, Corporation
foreignQualification.filedWith: Kansas Secretary of State, Business Services Division
foreignQualification.ongoingObligationsNote: File an information report every two years and maintain a resident agent in Kansas.

evidence.quote: The filing fee for the Foreign Application is as follows: All businesses:
FA - Foreign Application - LLC, LLP, LP, Corporation
Foreign (non-Kansas) business entities must file by submitting a foreign application by paper.
The Information Report is submitted every two years by any business on file with the Kansas Secretary of State.

Provide the name of the resident agent. Resident agent: This must be either an individual, a business registered in Kansas, or the business itself who will receive any legal documents (i.e. subpoenas, court orders, summons, etc.) for the business named in section 2.

notes: Foreign applications are paper-only in Kansas. The $115 fee appears in the FA form's fee schedule and on the form itself. The two-year information report carries its own fee; root states.json holds the LLC information-report figure.
